FormModule.Name: INVENTORY
FormModule.Title: Inventory Inquiry
FormModule.Comment: Stock position worklist by product/warehouse, with a manual quantity-adjustment action. Query source is LOM_INVENTORY_V.

ModuleParameter.Name: P_PRODUCT_ID
ModuleParameter.Comment: Optional: set when opened from ORDERS.fmb / BT_VIEW_INVENTORY (LOM-MOD-022).

ModuleParameter.Name: P_WAREHOUSE_CODE
ModuleParameter.Comment: Optional: defaults to LOM_INVENTORY_API.default_warehouse when not supplied (LOM-MOD-018).

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-018 (MANUAL_REVIEW, category F): the form correctly calls
 -- LOM_INVENTORY_API.default_warehouse rather than re-implementing the
 -- "first row where IS_DEFAULT='Y'" query inline -- so there is nothing to
 -- fix HERE. The flaw is one layer down, in the function itself: nothing
 -- in the schema prevents two warehouses from carrying IS_DEFAULT='Y' at
 -- once, so this call is silently non-deterministic if that ever happens.
 -- A human needs to decide whether the fix is a partial unique index
 -- (WHERE is_default = 'Y') or a documented single-admin-owned setting.
 IF :PARAMETER.P_WAREHOUSE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_INVENTORY', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'WAREHOUSE_CODE = ''' || :PARAMETER.P_WAREHOUSE_CODE || '''');
 ELSE
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_INVENTORY', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'WAREHOUSE_CODE = ''' || lom_inventory_api.default_warehouse || '''');
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_INVENTORY', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_INVENTORY', DEFAULT_WHERE)
 || ' AND PRODUCT_ID = ' || :PARAMETER.P_PRODUCT_ID);
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-035 (REPLACE_WITH_APEX_NATIVE): LOM_INVENTORY_V deliberately
 -- does not compute this (see database/views/lom_views.sql). Pure
 -- presentation derivation, kept in Forms on purpose so this lab has a
 -- clean "no PL/SQL to migrate, just a report attribute" example -- an
 -- Interactive Report highlight/format rule on QUANTITY_AVAILABLE <=
 -- REORDER_LEVEL replaces this trigger entirely.
 IF :BK_INVENTORY.QUANTITY_AVAILABLE <= :BK_INVENTORY.REORDER_LEVEL THEN
 :BK_INVENTORY.LOW_STOCK_FLAG := 'YES';
 ELSE
 :BK_INVENTORY.LOW_STOCK_FLAG := NULL;
 END IF;
END;

Item.Name: QUANTITY_AVAILABLE
Item.Tooltip: Virtual column: quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved (single authoritative definition, see LOM-MOD-025).

Item.Name: LOW_STOCK_FLAG
Item.Tooltip: Computed in POST-QUERY, not stored -- see LOM-MOD-035.

Item.Name: P_ADJUST_QTY
Item.Tooltip: Positive to receive stock, negative to write off; passed to LOM_INVENTORY_API.adjust_quantity as-is.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :BK_INVENTORY.P_ADJUST_QTY IS NULL OR :BK_INVENTORY.P_ADJUST_QTY = 0 THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Enter a non-zero adjustment quantity first.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 -- LOM-MOD-016 (PRESERVE): correctly delegates to
 -- LOM_INVENTORY_API.adjust_quantity instead of an inline UPDATE -- the
 -- direct contrast to APPROVALS.fmb's BT_APPROVE/BT_REJECT
 -- (LOM-MOD-041/LOM-MOD-042). Nothing to change here in APEX beyond the
 -- call site (a page process button).
 lom_inventory_api.adjust_quantity(
 p_product_id => :BK_INVENTORY.PRODUCT_ID,
 p_warehouse_code => :BK_INVENTORY.WAREHOUSE_CODE,
 p_delta => :BK_INVENTORY.P_ADJUST_QTY,
 p_changed_by => :GLOBAL.G_USER
 );
 COMMIT;
 :BK_INVENTORY.P_ADJUST_QTY := NULL;
 om_shared.show_message('Inventory adjusted.');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 ROLLBACK;
 om_shared.show_message('Adjustment failed: ' || SQLERRM);
END;
